title: One repair, every camera angle
idea: Orbit two synthetic Gaussian arches: one repair deliberately changes with the view; the other stays fixed in 3D. Inspect projected ellipses and overlapping opacity.
controls: Orbit, elevation, opacity, anisotropy, splat size, missing-region mode, footprint overlays; PNG/GIF export.
misconception: A convincing filled image is not evidence that all camera views describe the same scene. Shared geometry can still be wrong.
connection: WINGS · 29 Sep 2026. New interactive this week; synthetic illustration, not its model or evaluation.

title: What a cache remembers after you evict it
idea: Draw video chunks as nodes, with attention edges showing each cached chunk's ancestry. Evict visible nodes and reveal information still inherited by the survivors.
controls: Context-window length, ordinary versus self-caching, rollout duration, ancestry highlight.
misconception: A short KV cache does not necessarily contain only short-context information.
connection: ID-Forcing · 2 Oct 2026. Show cache provenance without fabricating generated-video quality.

title: Keep the subject without freezing the action
idea: A token-attention diagram follows reference anchors across a rollout. Inspect how stronger anchor influence can constrain identity and compete with new content.
controls: Reference gain, drift trigger, contrast guidance, prompt change and elapsed chunks.
misconception: Turning up reference conditioning is not a free improvement in both identity and motion.
connection: CustomForcing · 2 Oct 2026. Abstract conditioning visual; actual identity scores require a model run.

title: Camera guidance without losing every alternative
idea: Animate candidate camera trajectories, reward weights and resampling ancestry. Track effective sample size and surviving path diversity.
controls: Particle count, camera reward, aesthetic reward, restart budget and fixed compute budget.
misconception: Training-free camera guidance is not free of inference cost or diversity tradeoffs.
connection: PartiCam · 30 Sep 2026; carried forward from Friday's proposal, not a new release today.

title: Sound attached to a place
idea: Move a listener among fixed emitters and walls. Compare a soundtrack with geometry-linked left/right cues and occlusion.
controls: Listener path, emitter location, distance attenuation, wall toggle and binaural comparison.
misconception: A soundtrack that matches a scene is not necessarily audio that remains spatially attached as you move.
connection: Audible World Models · 29 Sep 2026. Its automatic scene geometry and source placement are static; no action-sync claim.

title: The empty space between plausible words
idea: Use labeled synthetic token islands and decoder regions to show how a denoised embedding can land between valid alternatives. Compare separated and connected regions.
controls: Candidate spacing, soft-label strength, sampling error, decoder confidence and entropy.
misconception: An embedding that separates words well is not automatically a good latent space for generation.
connection: Scaling and Distilling Text Embeddings · 1 Oct 2026. A 2D explanation would not be a measured projection of its 640D embeddings.
audience: ML practitioners learning diffusion language models

title: Where should the next sampling step go?
idea: Extend the existing sampler lab with a timeline of error estimates and evaluation spending. Compare uniform, adaptive and averaged schedules on the same analytic field.
controls: Absolute/relative tolerance, proportional/integral gains, evaluation budget and schedule choice.
misconception: Adaptive per-sample steps do not always outperform a well-chosen fixed schedule.
connection: Adaptive Second-Order Solvers · 2 Oct 2026. The current lab has fixed step counts; PI control is not implemented yet.

title: A music score is more than one score
idea: Break a music prompt into rubric criteria and compare pairwise preferences under different weights; expose cases where one dimension hides another.
controls: Rubric selection, per-criterion weights, judge disagreement, quality versus adherence display.
misconception: A higher automatic reward is not proof of better music for every listener.
connection: Rubric-Based Optimization for Text-to-Music · 2 Oct 2026. Synthetic preferences are illustrations, not a listening study.
